home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Everything runs on your computer. Nothing goes through AdsConsole servers.
home.steps_hint: Three steps for the AI to start working on your accounts.
home.step_connect_hint: Google Ads or Meta Ads, with your own app.
home.step_client_hint: Paste the ready-made snippet into Claude, Codex, Gemini or Cursor.
home.step_first_call_hint: Ask the AI something like "list my campaigns". This step checks itself.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autostart_hint: The MCPs are available as soon as you turn on your computer.
settings.port_hint: AI clients need the new port after you change it.
settings.secrets_keychain: System keychain. Tokens and keys stay in the operating system vault.
settings.secrets_file: Local file readable only by your user (the keychain was not available).
settings.up_to_date: You are on the latest version.

conn.title: Connections
conn.subtitle: Ad accounts the AI can access, through your own app on each platform.
conn.remove_desc: This connection credentials are deleted from the keychain. The AI loses access to its accounts.
conn.name: Connection name
conn.name_hint: Just for you to recognize it, e.g. Main agency.
conn.waiting_hint: Finish signing in in the browser window. It takes up to 5 minutes.
conn.templates: Privacy policy and redirect page templates

google.title: Connect Google Ads
google.desc: Uses your own Google Cloud project. Takes about 10 minutes the first time.
google.step1: Create a project and enable the Google Ads API
google.step2: Set up the consent screen and publish the app
google.step3: Create a Desktop app OAuth client and download the JSON
google.login_customer_hint: Only if you reach the accounts through an MCC.

meta.title: Connect Meta Ads
meta.desc: Uses your own app on Meta for Developers.
meta.step1: Create the app with the ads use case and link it to your business portfolio
meta.step2: Create the Facebook Login for Business configuration
meta.step3: To publish the app: privacy policy and redirect page
meta.relay_hint: Required with the app in Live mode. Leave empty in development mode.
meta.token_hint: System User or user token. It stays only in the keychain.

mcps.title: MCPs
mcps.subtitle: Local servers your AI client uses. They only accept calls from this computer with the token.
mcps.server_error: The MCP server is not running

where.terminal: Paste it in the terminal. The copied command includes the token.
where.claude_desktop: Paste it into claude_desktop_config.json (Settings → Developer → Edit config) and restart Claude Desktop. Requires Node.js.
where.cursor: Paste it into ~/.cursor/mcp.json and restart Cursor.

tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: What the AI can do on each platform. Applies right away, no restart.
tools.write_mode_hint: Approval: every change waits for your OK in AdsConsole. Direct: applies without asking.
tools.wait: How long the AI waits for approval (seconds)
tools.wait_hint: After that the request stays in the queue and the AI checks the result later.

group_hint.create: Campaigns, ad sets, ads and audiences (created paused).
group_hint.escape: Direct API access for uncovered cases. Off by default.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Changes the AI asked for, waiting for your OK. Nothing is applied without your decision.
approvals.empty_hint: When the AI asks for a write in approval mode, it shows up here and the system notifies you.
approvals.read_only: This platform is in read-only mode. Reject the request or change the mode in Tools.
approvals.closed: This request is no longer in the queue: {{status}}.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Everything the AI changed in your accounts, with undo.
history.undo_pending: The undo is waiting for approval.
history.orphans: These objects may have been left in the account. Check and delete them on the platform:

boot.keychain_title: The system keychain did not respond
boot.keychain_desc: AdsConsole tokens and keys live in the keychain. Without it, the app cannot open the connections or the MCP.
boot.keychain_retry_hint: Unlock the keychain (or allow access if the system asks) and try again.
boot.use_file_warning: Switching to a local file keeps secrets in a file readable only by your user. Connections must be redone and the MCP token changes: reconfigure your AI clients afterwards.
boot.fatal_desc: Error opening the data folder or the local database.

quit.title: Quit AdsConsole?
quit.pending_one: {{count}} pending approval will be rejected. Quit anyway?
quit.pending_other: {{count}} pending approvals will be rejected. Quit anyway?
